slides.headline: YOUR AIRPORT JUST GOT NEW TAXIS. NOBODY CALLED FIRST
slides.body: This is not how major rollouts go. Every time something changed at your airport, they warned you first. Not this time. And how the world found out? Even stranger.

slides.headline: SOMEONE WALKED PAST MIAMI AIRPORT AND STOPPED COLD
slides.body: No gate announcement. No press release. Just a person near Miami International who suddenly saw a row of identical, driverless cars sitting there, silent, no explanation. You'd have stopped too. They posted it.

caption:
Swipe to see how 35 Tesla Cybercabs appeared at Miami Airport with zero announcement and why one random X post was the only way the world found out. 📍

35 Tesla Cybercabs spotted at Miami International with no official word, the assumption that major deployments come with press releases, the cinematic moment a bystander stopped and saw them with no explanation, the absurdity of a top-10 US airport getting autonomous taxis with zero announcement, the hard numbers behind the quiet rollout, and what this means for airport rideshare drivers and businesses watching this unfold.

Autonomous vehicles are deploying without press releases or permission. The people whose livelihoods depend on those routes are the last to know.

Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what quiet automation means for yours.

Sources: Sawyer Merritt on X

editor_override: HOOK AND VIOLATION (§2): 'TESLA SILENTLY PLACED 35 DRIVERLESS CABS AT MIAMI AIRPORT AND A STRANGER WALKING BY IS THE ONLY REASON WE KNOW' has two actors (Tesla + a stranger). The law is ONE actor, ONE action — 'AND joining two actions = cut the weaker one.' Cut the stranger clause; the hook survives as 'TESLA SILENTLY PLACED 35 DRIVERLESS CABS AT MIAMI AIRPORT WITH ZERO ANNOUNCEMENT AND NOBODY KNE
